description: Supports aériens électriques / télécoms is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Géodatamine. Localisation des supports aériens électriques / télécoms dans le Tarn-et-Garonne. OpenStreetMap est bâti par une communauté de cartographes bénévoles qui contribuent et maintiennent les données des routes, sentiers, cafés, stations ferroviaires et bien plus encore, partout dans le monde. OpenStreetMap fournit les données cartographiques pour des milliers de sites web, d’applications mobiles et d’appareils. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Données territoriales. Its keywords are supports, aériens, telecom, tarn et garonne. The portal shows 3,544 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
